_comment: EVERYONE-BODY-MOCAP-OPPONENTS (2026-09-14). Each clip is a window of a real capture, retargeted by lib/babylon/anim/mocapRetarget.ts into lib/babylon/anim/authored/mocapOpponents.ts (npx tsx scripts/mocap/gen-opponent-clips.mts). `replaces` is the authored clip an OPPONENT plays this instead of (lib/babylon/anim/opponentMotion.ts). A beat keeps the duration of the clip it replaces so mode timing (the release, the settle) does not move; a loop keeps real time. Files are relative to ~/Downloads/fel-mocap-sources. Windows were read off scripts/mocap/stream-sheet.mts sheets and hand/foot signal tables.

clips.name: bball_mc_dribble_idle
clips.note: right-hand dribble, one bounce cycle (hand peaks 6.75 → 7.50)

clips.name: bball_mc_crossover_right
clips.note: low freestyle: the LEFT hand carries across to the right hip (going right)

clips.name: bball_mc_crossover_left
clips.note: the same capture mirrored

clips.name: bball_mc_hesi
clips.note: a hard low dribble: the ball hand drops to 1.16 torso, hips dip, then back up

clips.name: bball_mc_jumpshot
clips.note: set at the chest, dip (2.30–2.55), rise, release at the top (2.85–2.95)

clips.name: bball_mc_follow_through
clips.note: the release held through the fall and the landing

clips.name: karate_mc_hit_react
clips.note: the first 0.3 s of the knockback: the flinch

clips.name: karate_mc_knockdown
clips.note: hit, knocked off the feet onto the back

clips.name: karate_mc_get_up
clips.note: from the back to standing

clips.name: dunk_mc_celebrate_big
clips.note: the owner's own take: hands come up from the chest to both arms overhead (a rival's win / a big make)

clips.name: bball_mc_defend_slide_right
clips.note: DefensiveMoveSideToSide: low wide stance, arms out, one push-and-gather step to the RIGHT (hips travel +2.6 torso)

clips.name: bball_mc_defend_slide_left
clips.note: the same drill back to the LEFT

clips.name: bball_mc_spin
clips.note: OffensiveMoveSpinLeft: plant, reverse pivot and spin off the defender

clips.name: bball_mc_run
clips.note: RunningNoBall: one full stride cycle, arms free (a body without the ball)

clips.name: bball_mc_dribble_run
clips.note: RunningStraight: a stride cycle dribbling on the run (the ball hand works low)

clips.name: bball_mc_drive
clips.note: the drive (run_forward) is the same dribbling stride

clips.name: bball_mc_defend_stance
clips.note: the low wide stance held between slides, arms out

clips.name: karate_mc_jab
clips.note: boxing: the LEFT jab of a combo, reach peaks 0.51 m at 3.04 (find-strikes.mts)

clips.name: karate_mc_hook
clips.note: boxing: the RIGHT hand that follows the jab, reach peak 3.30

clips.name: karate_mc_roundhouse
clips.note: karate Mawashigeri: right roundhouse, the foot peaks at 1.35 m at 1.00

clips.name: karate_mc_high_kick
clips.note: karate front kick: right leg, the foot peaks at 1.00 m at 3.13

clips.name: bball_mc_layup_gather
clips.note: basketball lay up: the gather low (2.2–2.9) into the rise, both hands carrying the ball up to 1.9 m

clips.name: football_mc_run
clips.note: a defender's pursuit stride: CMU 78 RunningNoBall (the same cycle as bball_mc_run, in the football scope)
